mechanism: Duloxetine inhibits CYP1A2 which metabolizes ethinyl estradiol, potentially increasing oral contraceptive levels and efficacy while also increasing duloxetine exposure; additionally, SNRIs may have additive effects on hemostasis.
action: Monitor for increased duloxetine side effects and counsel on signs of bleeding; contraceptive efficacy is unlikely to be reduced but breakthrough bleeding risk may increase; consider alternative antidepressant if significant adverse effects occur.
